title: ARMS
summary: ARMS is Nintendo's 2017 fighting game, and it runs on Switch 2 with a free update rather than a paid upgrade pack. The install is only 3.2 GB, and the Switch 1 cartridge holds the full game and works in a Switch 2. Multiplayer is the main draw: up to 4 players on one console, up to 4 over local wireless and up to 4 online. Because it was designed around motion controls, check that you have enough Joy-Con controllers for the number of players you want before a game night. Spanish is one of its 11 supported languages.
